opening.argument: The video presents a concrete cryptocurrency transfer flow built around a front-running bot and substantial promised returns. It advertises “How to EARN 10 BNB EVERY DAY,” describes a bot that “will front run all the retail Investors that come in,” and reports that the result is “already around 15x.” The instructions then direct viewers to deploy the contract through a wallet, deposit BNB, and activate it after confirmation, including a recommendation to fund the deposit to 1.0 BNB. The promised returns are therefore tied to an actual deposit and bot-activation process, not merely general discussion. The stated recovery process requires yet another transfer to the deployed contract before executing the action, reinforcing the same flow of requested cryptocurrency transfers.
